summary: A 43-year-old man was reported missing after last being seen May 24, 2021. His vehicle was found at Riverfront Clifton Nature Park; the Mesa County Sheriff's Office searched the Colorado River and surrounding area without locating him as of the June 1 report.
location: Riverfront Clifton Nature Park, near 32 1/2 Road and D Road, Clifton
notes: Kool 107.9 report published June 1, 2021. Date is the reported last-seen date; search dates are not specified. Outcome reflects that report, not a current missing-person status. Unconfirmed social-media drowning claims are not treated as established facts.
